question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Antique
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Ancient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Antique"** refers to something that is old and valuable, especially an object that belongs to a past era and holds historical or artistic significance. (प्राचीन वस्तु)

 
 
• **Example:** The museum had a beautiful collection of antique furniture from the 18th century.
 
 
 
• **"Ancient"** means something that is very old, belonging to a period of history that is long past, or something that has existed for a very long time. (प्राचीन)
 
 
• **Example:** The pyramids of Egypt are ancient structures that have withstood the test of time.
 
 
 
• Both "Antique" and "Ancient" denote an association with the past, but "Ancient" specifically means very old in general, making it the most appropriate synonym for "Antique".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Ancient**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Novel **(नया): Something new, unusual, or original.

 
 
• **Example:** The scientist came up with a novel approach to solving the energy crisis.
 
 
 
• **Young **(युवा): Refers to something or someone in the early stages of growth or development.
 
 
• **Example:** The young boy was eager to learn about the world around him.
 
 
 
• **Modern **(आधुनिक): Refers to something related to the present or recent times, as opposed to the past.
 
 
• **Example:** The building was designed with a modern architectural style..
